description:
Nightcall is an on-call fixer: paste a production alert, have Anna's LLM analyze its actual content (error type, functions, file:line, fields, service), and get a root cause with evidence plus a minimal patch.

Key features
- AI triage in seconds: the bundled tool extracts concrete evidence from your alert and asks Anna's LLM (via sampling, on your plan — no API keys) for a specific diagnosis.
- Evidence-cited results: every answer lists what it used (functions, files, fields) with a confidence level.
- Honest by design: nothing is executed — no reproduction, no test runs. Results say so explicitly; you validate in your own repo.
- Works everywhere: multi-platform binaries run locally and on Cloud Agents; last run saved via Anna Storage.

Who it's for
On-call developers, SREs and small teams who want alert-to-patch in minutes without wiring LLM keys.

How to get started
1. Install Nightcall (enable LLM sampling for the bundled tool when asked). 2. Open the Nightcall window. 3. Paste an alert with its stack trace. 4. Click Analyze. 5. Review the cited evidence, apply the patch in your repo, run your tests, open a PR.
name: Nightcall - On-Call Fixer
tagline: Alert to AI-analyzed patch in minutes
